queries.naturalLanguage: Monthly net revenue by product category for the last 12 months.
queries.sql:
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('month', o.ordered_at) AS month,
  p.category,
  SUM(o.net_revenue_usd) AS net_revenue_usd
FROM analytics.fct_orders o
JOIN analytics.dim_products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.ordered_at >= DATEADD(month, -12, CURRENT_DATE())
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2;
lintWarnings: Large scan on fct_orders; consider clustering on ordered_at.

queries.naturalLanguage: What percent of customers who bought in January came back in February?
queries.sql:
WITH jan_buyers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT customer_id
  FROM analytics.fct_orders
  WHERE ordered_at >= '2026-01-01' AND ordered_at < '2026-02-01'
),
feb_buyers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT customer_id
  FROM analytics.fct_orders
  WHERE ordered_at >= '2026-02-01' AND ordered_at < '2026-03-01'
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS jan_customers,
  COUNT(f.customer_id) AS returned_in_feb,
  returned_in_feb / NULLIF(jan_customers, 0) AS repeat_rate
FROM jan_buyers j
LEFT JOIN feb_buyers f ON j.customer_id = f.customer_id;

queries.naturalLanguage: ROAS by campaign for Q1 2026, sorted worst to best.
queries.sql: SELECT campaign_name, SUM(attributed_revenue) / NULLIF(SUM(spend_usd), 0) AS roas FROM campaign_spend WHERE spend_month >= '2026-01-01' AND spend_month < '2026-04-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY roas ASC NULLS LAST;

queries.naturalLanguage: Average CSAT by customer tier for tickets closed last 30 days.
queries.sql: SELECT tier, AVG(score) FROM csat_responses r JOIN tickets t ON r.ticket_id = t.id WHERE t.closed_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY tier;

queries.naturalLanguage: Order share by channel when channel is not null.
queries.sql: SELECT channel, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders FROM analytics.fct_orders WHERE channel IS NOT NULL AND ordered_at >= DATEADD(day, -90, CURRENT_DATE()) GROUP BY 1;
